what: The owner's answer to the draft comparison of Reality Engineering with labeling guide v2.1 and its 11 worked examples.
question_asked: Do those proposed answers match what you mean? Reply `yes`, or send the example numbers you would change.
author: Wakil (user_01UqhXHPKVBkd2haEgKvo45Q), in the project chat, copied verbatim by the server into a coordinator relay

settled_by_this_answer.1: Positive: one ^2 entry per thing the Mind is drawn to (W029: the dodgems, the Ferris wheel, the ring toss game).
settled_by_this_answer.2: Negative: indifference is a weak ^4, not ^3 (W003).
settled_by_this_answer.3: Vibration: the ^4 label states how hard the Idea hit the Mind, not how the thing is (W005).
settled_by_this_answer.4: Female and Rhythm: each Idea that is part of who the Mind is gets its own ^5 (a role taken on; a routine imprinted); the repetition words are ^7 (W002).
settled_by_this_answer.5: Male: the related thing is the whole the passage says the parts make up, named in full, never a pointer (W020 the faulty tanning machine; W023 the machine's unresponsiveness).
settled_by_this_answer.6: Male: a list of things a Mind notices is not ^6; a thing is never its own part (W001).
settled_by_this_answer.7: Owner's open question 1 answered yes: recognizing a sign that brings another Idea to Mind is a clear ^8 -> ^9 pair (book p.51, the empty carton and 'I need milk'; W022).
settled_by_this_answer.9: Which Effect: pair the trigger with what the passage says it reminded the Mind of; further parts of that memory are ^9 entries of the same trigger (W059).
settled_by_this_answer.10: A memory that simply follows a sign, with no linking word, is an uncertain pair; a clear pair needs a link such as 'reminded', 'brought back', 'made him think of' (W005).
settled_by_this_answer.11: Rule 3 stays: ^8 and ^9 only when an Idea comes to a being that thinks; the book's physical examples (gravity, heat, light) are Physical-world Elements, not passage labels.
settled_by_this_answer.8: Settled by the owner's ruling of 2026-10-07 1:47 PM PDT (owner_ruling_example_8): both relationships allowed when each meets its own definition; reasoning does not by itself exclude a Cause; evidence is not Male unless an identifiable Idea contains it; W137: Cause and Effect, no Male.

what_it_does_not_do: It changes nothing in guide v2.1 or in the finished v2.1 run. A new attempt still needs new passages and a new plan version, reviewed and signed by the owner, before anything runs or is spent.
